summary: First test run for BuildSphere. Backend pytest 22/22 passing (auth, RBAC, marketplace, orders+demo payments, tenders with reverse-auction ranking, solar calc+quotes, ERP projects/BOQ/DPR, AI tender-summary + AI chat SSE). Frontend E2E validated: login for all 4 roles routes to correct dashboards (Super Admin Panel with charts, Vendor Portal, Customer Dashboard, Contractor Workspace); marketplace add-to-cart -> Cart tab -> demo checkout marks order 'paid' and lists in My Orders; Tender detail shows live countdown, live bid ranking, and AI Tender Summary generates real bullet output; AI floating widget opens and streams a reply. Razorpay in DEMO mode as intended.

issues: Demo account chips (abbhuadaya@gmail.com, vendor/customer/contractor@buildsphere.in) lack data-testid attributes. Task spec expects them to auto-fill on click; a small data-testid like demo-admin/demo-vendor etc. would help test automation. Manual fill still works.

action_items: Optional: add data-testid="demo-admin|demo-vendor|demo-customer|demo-contractor" to the four demo-credential chips on /login so tests can click-to-fill.

Optional: two 500 responses were logged in browser console when switching accounts (likely a previously-open /api/ai/chat SSE aborted on navigation). Not user-visible; consider aborting fetch on unmount in AIAssistant.jsx to remove console noise.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is a single 820-line module. As features grow, split into routers/ (auth, admin, marketplace, tenders, solar, erp, ai) and models.py.
resolve_user() ignores JWT exp errors silently; consider distinguishing expired vs malformed for better client UX.
seed() runs on every startup — idempotent but re-hashes admin password each boot; low-cost but wasteful.
CORS: allow_origins defaults to '*' with allow_credentials=True which browsers reject for cookies; harmless here because frontend uses Bearer tokens, but tighten CORS_ORIGINS in prod.
/api/tenders/{id}/award has no ownership check — any customer/contractor/super_admin can award any tender.
vendor/orders endpoint uses a Python-side loop with await inside any(...) generator (works but O(n*m) DB hits); acceptable for demo scale.
seed_data_creation: Backend auto-seeds admin + 3 demo users + 6 products + 3 tenders on startup. Tests additionally create TEST_-prefixed users/tenders/projects/quotes; not cleaned up but namespaced.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 22 backend tests pass via `pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v`. Login uses Bearer token in localStorage bs_token (no cookies needed for API). Razorpay intentionally in DEMO mode — /api/payments/create returns {mode:'demo'} and /api/payments/verify with mode='demo' marks order paid. AI tender-summary and chat SSE both work with EMERGENT_LLM_KEY (Claude sonnet-4-6). Demo chip buttons on /login lack data-testid — fill fields manually via login-email/login-password/login-submit selectors.
